title: Expected amenable subalgebras preserving core commutants
summary: We prove that every inclusion $`N\subset M`$ of von Neumann algebras with separable preduals and a faithful normal conditional expectation contains an expected amenable subalgebra $`P\subset N`$ such that $`P'\cap c(M)=N'\cap c(M)`$, where $`c(M)`$ denotes the continuous core of M . This resolves the relative bicentralizer conjecture in this setting.
family_title: Relative bicentralizers and modular spectral recovery

review.reason: Proves existence of amenable subalgebras preserving core commutants, resolving a relative bicentralizer conjecture.
